package message

import (
	"github.com/Chronicle20/atlas/libs/atlas-kafka/message"
	"github.com/Chronicle20/atlas/libs/atlas-kafka/topic"
	"github.com/Chronicle20/atlas/libs/atlas-model/model"
)

type Buffer struct {
	buffer map[topic.Token][]message.Message
}

func NewBuffer() *Buffer {
	return &Buffer{
		buffer: make(map[topic.Token][]message.Message),
	}
}

func (b *Buffer) Put(t topic.Token, p model.Provider[[]message.Message]) error {
	ms, err := p()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	b.buffer[t] = append(b.buffer[t], ms...)
	return nil
}

func (b *Buffer) GetAll() map[topic.Token][]message.Message {
	return b.buffer
}
